primary_endpoint: Paired equal-book validation loss after 26110 source observations, reporting every arm and all three seeds.
secondary_endpoints: Each early-reader retention loss change from stage one to stage two; each stage-two training book before and after introduction; source-update loss, firing, logged gradient norms and above-clip counts; all four raw generation prompts at both endpoints.
scope: Fresh randomized founders on the unchanged first two prose stages. Same source, replay, speech, optimizer and logging policy; only the declared objective changes. Coefficients are an exploratory logarithmic comparison, not matched-gradient penalties or biological ages.
limits: No model promotion, teacher or reproduction admission, reserved test scoring, or coefficient selection by activity alone. Source-update clipping uses rounded logged norms; equality to the clip is recorded separately. Replay-update gradient norms are not logged. Full-curriculum language, 411M transfer and new-science retention remain separate work.
